verdict.rationale: Benchmark Email's AI Assistant writes copy and creates images inside the email builder. That is content generation, not operating the product (managing lists, campaigns or contacts) through natural-language commands. The REST API and llms.txt file are developer building blocks or LLM-readable docs, not a natural-language control interface. No evidence shows a conversational or command interface for driving the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
